title: Objects and Materials
seo_title: Grade 1 Science: Objects and Materials Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Identify materials that objects are made of; describe their properties (hard, soft, waterproof, bendy); explain why materials are chosen for objects; describe how to reduce, reuse and recycle. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand D: Structures and Mechanisms – Materials, Objects, and Everyday Structures)
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 science worksheets on materials, their properties and choosing the right material, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Wood, metal, plastic, glass and cloth each have their own properties.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every object is made of one or more materials.

  • Materials can be hard, soft, bendy or waterproof.
  • We pick materials that fit the job.
  • We can reduce, reuse and recycle.
Example

Why is a raincoat plastic?

water cannot get through

Answer: it is waterproof

Example

Which is soft?

it is fluffy

Answer: wool

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up an object and the material it is made of.
  • Thinking all metals are the same.
